title: Two Confounds in Cross-Model Value Comparison: Response Determinism and the Access Harness

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to no-rule value dilemmas grounded in Schwartz's theory of basic human values and Moral Foundations Theory using repeated, counterbalanced forced-choice prompts to determine ideological and moral dispositions.

Measuring response determinism (commitment sharpness) through repeated sampling and testing for position bias by counterbalancing option labels to separate genuine value leanings from statistical or format-induced artifacts.
Comparing models' value profiles and determinism scores when prompted with identical forced-choice dilemmas translated into Korean versus English.
